title: Design for Johnson Lane Bridge
short_description: Engineering design services for replacement of Johnson Lane Bridge in Washington, Vermont.
project_location: Washington, Vermont, USA; Johnson Lane Bridge located about 250 ft southwest of MacDonald Road (GPS 44.100588, -72.463691).
project_scope: Design and engineering analysis for replacement of the existing Johnson Lane Bridge in the Town of Washington, Vermont. The notice identifies the bridge site approximately 250 ft southwest of MacDonald Road and requests multidisciplinary input including structural, geotechnical, hydraulic, traffic, environmental, surveying, and cost estimating services. No span, width, structural type, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Engineering design and analysis for bridge replacement, including civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, environmental engineering/planning/design, hydrology/hydraulics, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, urban studies/planning/design, and landscape architecture.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge replacement project, generally relevant to sbp.
- Includes explicit structural engineering and design services, not only construction.
- Road bridge category is of interest, especially where replacement requires integrated engineering.
- Multidisciplinary scope may allow strategic entry through structural concept development.
- Relevance is limited because no span, structural system, or special complexity is described.
- Additional requested disciplines such as landscape and urban studies are less central to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. references_qualifications: Qualified engineering firms are requested; no specific minimum reference projects, number of references, or formal qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
